subject: Ref No: FOI-26-46 (Mapping information Ty Mawr/ Great House Farm/ Red Fen (Cedfin), Llandough, Cardiff) – Acknowledgement of receipt of your clarification response
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear [family member],
Thank you for your email of today, 29 October 2026, clarifying your request.
As you are aware, under FOI we are obliged to provide you with a response within 20 working days.  However, as we requested clarification the 20 working days starts the day after receipt of the necessary clarification. Therefore, the revised deadline for response is 26 November 2026, however, we will endeavour to reply as soon as possible.
In exceptional circumstances it may be necessary for Ordnance Survey to extend this date to consider a complex public interest argument if engaging a qualified exemption.  In such cases we will notify you of the revised date by which we would expect to provide a response.
Should you need to contact Ordnance Survey regarding your request at any time, please quote the allocated reference number in your correspondence.
Many thanks again and with kind regards,
Nikki

Nikki Osborne for the FOI Team
